library_summary_es: La evidencia depende mucho de la preparación, dosis, población y objetivo; no debe extrapolarse entre extractos diferentes.
questions_to_resolve: What specific clinical indication and population is studied?
Does benefit exceed placebo and meet clinically meaningful threshold?
What form, dose, duration and outcome were studied?
Which contraindications, interactions and special populations matter?
Which canonical questionnaire questions are required?
safety_research: Verify authoritative compound-specific warnings, medication interactions, pregnancy/lactation and comorbidities; do not infer safety from class.
note: Catalog information and broad source pointers are not sufficient for clinical approval.
